parameters.coordinate_domain: real algebraic coordinates in one common real algebraic number field

source_review.definition: Equal-weight spherical strength-5 designs of distinct unit points in R4; minimize point count. Full 126 monomial equations, not a sampled numerical design.
source_review.primary_sources: Bondarenko/Radchenko/Viazovska Annals2013 p444 gives 22 <= N(3,5) <= 24 and D4 design. Lindblad 2025 Designs Related Through Projective and Hopf Maps section3 still calls the 24-point design putatively optimal. 2026 S2 strength4 closure and odd-sphere construction results do not prove the S3 strength5 minimum.
source_review.human_reconstruction: Eight signed unit axes plus sixteen half-integer sign vectors form a rational rotation of the D4 roots. Root independently computed all 126 exact moments and norms. This is a reproduced classical construction, not an optimality certificate.
source_review.independent_method: Separate symbolic real-root expression arithmetic and Dirichlet rising-factorial moment formula, with all 126 moments for each of the five programs; formal checker instead uses explicit rational polynomial quotient arithmetic.
source_review.coordinate_model: Any finite real solution of the rational sphere/moment equations and distinctness inequalities has a real-algebraic solution by real-closed-field transfer. A common primitive real number field therefore preserves finite minimum; no arbitrary field-degree or coefficient caps.
source_review.cold_start_and_search: Standalone 96-point signed-permutation seed of (1,1,2,0)/sqrt6. Traditional integer-pattern scan and evolution produce 24 without reading human/reference witnesses. Exact checker and independent audits passed.
source_review.admission: All five programs, strict replay, whole-return declaration invariance, broken duplicate-point witnesses, cold export and failure controls passed.
